input.features: log-mel 80 bands (ln(mel_power+1e-10)), 20 Hz-16 kHz, n_fft 4096, start-aligned to the music2latent frame grid (~93 ms hop)

standardize.note: x_in = (logmel - mean)/std; foldable into layer 0: W' = W/std (per input), b' = b - (W/std)@mean

output: raw 64-d music2latent frame; match with pack centre/L2 as in match.py
budget_note: kb/07: 5-9 M MACs/frame fp32 fits in 25% of one Cortex-A7 core @10.77 Hz; this net is 0.102 M MACs (~1.5% of the mid-budget) via RTNeural fp32
